coordinate: K_t = (F_h, phi, T, s, sigma, X_t)

sigma.meaning: learning/binding state: evidence about behavior, never structure

separators.why: a learned binding must never be readable as fold identity, phase or topology, so the learning record is a closed object with no fold/phase/extent key

burner_observation.shape: tau = (F_h, phi, T, s, Q, input, operation, output, evidence)
burner_observation.role: proposal evidence until Ch'en assertion and Xul commit

invariants.FC1: a runtime coordinate declares the six fields F_h, phi, T, s, sigma and X_t as separate records; no field carries two meanings
invariants.FC2: the learning record is a closed object with no fold, phase or extent key, so sigma can never be read as structure
invariants.FC3: a learning update copies F_h verbatim: learning state cannot alter fold identity, phase or topology
invariants.FC4: recording a coordinate at a non-Xul phase never implies commit; the coordinate authority block always denies semantic authority and commit
invariants.FC5: replay distinguishes fold state, phase state and learned binding state, and counts the changes of each independently
invariants.FC6: a Burner observation is proposal evidence: it is never verified, never authoritative, and never commits
invariants.FC7: only a verified Xul request may apply a topology delta; every request is journaled with its typed refusal reason
